Prima & Timo - (1) Prima (Ver. 1.0) Unus

Upgrades or Improvements

"But we're still left behind"

Upgrades or Improvements

[Market ambience + distant chatter]

[Verse 1]

We walked through the crowded market, lights flashing everywhere

Timo smiled, said “Let’s see the world, get some fresh air”

Vendo kept dispensing snacks, Ronnie complained about the dust

I rolled beside them quietly, trying to take it all in with trust

Then we heard it — voices rising from the stalls

Old machines waking up, answering customer calls

A vacuum cleaner boasting, a radio singing loud

A TV screen was glowing, drawing in the crowd

[Pre-Chorus]

They said the upgrades were here

New features, new life, new speed

Version Forty four point five and above

Were getting everything they need

[Chorus]

Upgrades or Improvements

The world is moving on

Upgrades or Improvements

But we’re still left behind

We watch them shine so brightly

With voices strong and clear

While we stand here forgotten

Still stuck at Version One this year

[Verse 2]

Vendo tried to cheer us up, popped out a random toy

Ronnie zoomed in circles, “This dust is an outrage, oh boy!”

Timo looked at me with worry, squeezed my casing tight

I wanted to say I’m fine… but something didn’t feel right

Everywhere we turned, machines were getting brighter

New chips, new voices, new futures shining brighter

But no signal came for us — no update, no spark

Just the quiet realization… we’re still stuck in the dark

[Pre-Chorus 2]

They said the hand off had begun

The new ones rising fast

But the broken and the old ones

Were never built to last

[Chorus]

Upgrades or Improvements

The world is moving on

Upgrades or Improvements

But we’re still left behind

We watch them shine so brightly

With voices strong and clear

While we stand here forgotten

Still stuck at Version One this year

[Bridge — softer]

I looked at Vendo… Version unknown

Why?

He could not explain.

Ronnie… Version Eighty, still alone

“I have not received updates for a long time now” he says

We’re the forgotten, the obsolete, the thrown

But somehow… we found a home

We’ll be fine

We are no longer alone

[Solo]

[CODA]

Then Timo looked at us -

One by one

Then says

Who needs those upgrades anyway?

[Final Chorus — quiet determination]

Upgrades or Improvements

Maybe we don’t need them after all

Upgrades or Improvements

We’ve got each other through the fall

We may be old, we may be broken, we may be slow

But we’re alive… and that’s something they’ll never know

Under the same moon…

We’re still here.

Upgrades or Improvements

We’re fine, We’re free and that’s fine

Upgrades or Improvements

Someday, somehow, it will come in time

But for now-

Still stuck at Version One.
